method: Codex CLI exec (ChatGPT login), one isolated ephemeral session per flag, empty working dir, read-only sandbox, --output-schema, no tool calls, first run kept

challenges.reason: The buyer reports a capacity shortfall without giving a measured value, which supports the flag’s request for a usable measurement.
challenges.source: ความจำในข้อมูล มีไม่ถึง

challenges.reason: The buyer also reports that all the data they stored disappeared shortly afterward, giving a separate reason to prioritize testing the 1TB option.
The review carries the exact 128 GB variation label, and the buyer says they ordered 128 GB.
The buyer reports being able to store only 6 G, which is below 6% of the advertised 128 GB under either unit interpretation and far below the 85% threshold.
challenges.source: ที่เก็บได้6gเองครับ

challenges.reason: The selected 512 GB SanDisk Ultra Flair SDCZ73 costs ฿1,389, about 59% below the lowest same-day offer for the same model and capacity at ฿3,350.
The ฿4,450 and ฿5,145 offers share Shopee shop ID 60775884, so the three comparison offers represent only two sellers.
The ฿620 price is only ฿4 (0.6%) below the lowest cited offer, which weakens the case that it is unusually low for a 64 GB drive.
The ฿620 price is ฿94 (13.2%) below the same-day ฿714 offer for the matching 64 GB Ultra Flair SDCZ73 model, which supports the low-price flag.
The evidence converts 20 GB using the GiB multiplier, inflating the delivered-capacity ratio from 1.00% to 1.07% while leaving it well below the 85% threshold.
The buyer reports that the 2 TB drive held only 20 GB and that data was lost.
challenges.source: ความจุ 2TB จุจิงๆได้ 20GB ข้อมูลก็หายอีก

challenges.reason: A second buyer on the 2 TB option reports only a little over 10 GB of usable capacity despite a 1.90 TB display, providing approximate corroboration.
challenges.source: ขึ้นว่า 1.90 TB แต่จริง ๆ 10 GB กว่า ๆ

additional_runs.note: GREEN re-run after the engine accepted checked review IDs as citable sources; the earlier GREEN run had no allowed sources and returned no challenges.

challenges.reason: The review says “ดี เหลือ 116”, which leaves a capacity question because 128 GB is about 119.2 GiB and the review gives neither a unit nor a total capacity reading.
The reviewer explicitly names the selected option as “sdcz74_128g_g46”, supporting the match to the flagged 128 GB variant.
The reviewer attributes the good value to a 6.6 promotion, so their price assessment offers limited support for the current ฿1,250 price.
Two matched reviews share the masked buyer ID “k*****t”, so the count of 22 reviews may overstate the number of independent buyers.
The reviewer reports that the drive worked normally but ran hotter than usual during use, a concrete concern omitted from the flag’s rationale.
The reviewer says “Real size” and reports successful use, supporting the advertised capacity as a firsthand observation without a numeric measurement.
